title: PharmaAgent: a real-world evaluation of high- and low-autonomy agentic systems for inpatient vancomycin dosing
zh_title: PharmaAgent：住院万古霉素给药智能体的真实世界评估
summary: 在斯坦福医院静默部署LLM万古霉素给药智能体两个月，比较高自主与低自主配置的给药准确性与安全性。
key_points: 316例患者403次给药事件，与药师医嘱对比
高自主组误差21.8%，低自主组37.8%
196条超容差建议中65.8%被药师认定存在安全隐患
reason: 真实医院前瞻性静默部署、样本可观并含安全性人工复核，但为预印本且未报临床结局
abstract: Vancomycin has a narrow therapeutic window requiring individualized dosing and repeated monitoring, a process health systems delegate from physicians to pharmacists for consistency. We silently deployed PharmaAgent, LLM-based vancomycin dosing agentic systems, at Stanford Hospital for two months and compared high- and low-autonomy configurations, each with and without institutional guidelines. Across 403 dosing events in 316 patients, mean absolute percentage error against the treating pharmacist's order was 21.8% with high autonomy versus 37.8% with low autonomy, and recommendations were within 25% of the order in 73.4% versus 50.9% of events (P < 0.001); a second pharmacist was within 25% in 90.2%. Pharmacist review of 196 out-of-tolerance recommendations found a safety concern in 65.8%, more often with low autonomy (odds ratio 2.37). A higher-autonomy agent that self-debugged its intermediate steps proved more robust than stricter engineering, but neither configuration is ready to dose patients without pharmacist oversight.
zh_abstract: 万古霉素治疗窗窄，需要个体化给药和反复监测，这一流程由卫生系统从医师委托给药师以保证一致性。我们在斯坦福医院静默部署了基于LLM的万古霉素给药智能体系统PharmaAgent，为期两个月，并比较了高自主性与低自主性配置，每种配置分别在有和没有机构指南的情况下运行。在316名患者的403次给药事件中，与治疗药师医嘱相比的平均绝对百分比误差在高自主性下为21.8%，低自主性下为37.8%；推荐意见与医嘱相差在25%以内的事件分别占73.4%和50.9%（P < 0.001）；第二位药师的相差在25%以内比例为90.2%。药师对196条超出容差范围的推荐意见进行审查，发现65.8%存在安全性顾虑，低自主性下更常见（比值比2.37）。一个会自我调试其中间步骤的更高自主性智能体被证明比更严格的工程化设计更稳健，但两种配置均未准备好在没有药师监督的情况下为患者给药。

title: Algorithmic design choices as determinants of health equity: a causal simulation study of healthcare resource allocation
zh_title: 算法设计选择如何影响医疗资源分配公平性
summary: 基于 All of Us 约 20 万成年人电子病历与调查数据的模拟研究，评估三种算法设计选择对资源分配公平性的影响。

abstract: Background. Care management programs increasingly rely on prediction algorithms to decide which patients receive limited healthcare resources. Because these algorithms are typically trained to predict future healthcare utilization or cost, they may systematically underidentify patients whose care-seeking behavior is suppressed by structural barriers. Objective. To evaluate how three modifiable design choices (selection threshold, feature set, and training objective) affect allocation equity in care management targeting. Methods. We constructed an analytical cohort of 201,216 adults from linked electronic health record and participant survey data in the NIH All of Us Research Program (2017-2019). Three prediction models (logistic regression, random forest, and XGBoost) were trained and evaluated under simulation conditions that varied one design choice at a time while holding the others fixed. Equity was assessed using false negative rate (FNR), equal opportunity difference (EOD), and allocation rate conditional on need (an access-independent benchmark based on self-reported general health status). We also applied Oaxaca-Blinder decomposition to identify which predictors contributed most to the Black-White allocation gap. Results. Prior utilization understated self-reported health burden among disadvantaged groups: 33% of Black and 32% of Hispanic participants reported fair or poor health, yet only 22% and 19% were classified as high utilizers. White participants showed the opposite pattern: 25% were classified as high utilizers, while only 19% reported fair or poor general health status. Under baseline design choices, all three models produced similar disparities, with uninsured participants showing the largest gap (EOD: -0.148). Oaxaca-Blinder decomposition identified prior outpatient visits as the dominant contributor to the Black-White gap in predicted allocation, with higher average emergency department utilization among Black participants partially offsetting the effect. Varying the selection threshold had little effect; disparities persisted across all thresholds. Feature set variation produced mixed and group-specific effects; removal of prior outpatient visits achieved near-zero Black-White EOD (0.001, AUC: 0.77), consistent with the Oaxaca-Blinder decomposition finding. Training objective variation produced the most substantial and consistent equity effects, with the health status objective achieving near-zero Black-White EOD (0.008, AUC: 0.69) an

abstract: [Journal of environmental pathology, toxicology and oncology : official organ of the International Society for Environmental Toxicology and Cancer] Non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC) represents the majority of lung cancer cases and remains the leading cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide. Early detection, accurate staging, and individualized therapy are crucial for improving patient survival. Recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI) have transformed NSCLC care through the automated analysis of imaging, pathology, and molecular datasets. Deep learning (DL) and machine learning (ML) models, particularly convolutional neural networks (CNNs), have demonstrated high accuracy in tumor detection, histologic classification, biomarker prediction (PD-L1, EGFR, KRAS) and prognosis assessment. Integration of the AI with whole slide imaging (WSI), computed tomography (CT), PET/CT and liquid biopsies enables non-invasive tumor characterization, early recurrence detection and prediction of treatment response. Multimodal AI approaches that combine imaging, genomic, and clinical data offer superior patient stratification and personalized treatment planning compared with traditional methods. Beyond diagnosis, AI facilitates therapeutic development through radiomics based nodule classification, multi-omics data interpretation, and drug discovery. Radiomics, in particular, extracts quantitative imaging biomarkers that capture tumor heterogeneity beyond human perception. The AI further supports clinical decision-making in surgery, radiotherapy, and systemic therapy, enhancing workflow efficiency. Despite challenges in data quality, interpretability, and clinical adoption, AI holds significant promise for advancing precision oncology and improving outcomes in NSCLC management.
zh_abstract: [Journal of environmental pathology, toxicology and oncology : official organ of the International Society for Environmental Toxicology and Cancer] 非小细胞肺癌（non-small-cell lung cancer, NSCLC）占肺癌病例的大多数，并且仍然是全球癌症相关死亡的主要原因。早期发现、准确分期和个体化治疗对于提高患者生存率至关重要。人工智能（artificial intelligence, AI）的最新进展通过自动分析影像、病理和分子数据集，改变了NSCLC的诊疗。深度学习（deep learning, DL）和机器学习（machine learning, ML）模型，尤其是卷积神经网络（convolutional neural networks, CNNs），在肿瘤检测、组织学分类、生物标志物预测（PD-L1、EGFR、KRAS）和预后评估方面表现出高准确度。AI与全切片成像（whole slide imaging, WSI）、计算机断层扫描（computed tomography, CT）、PET/CT和液体活检的整合，能够实现无创肿瘤表征、早期复发检测和治疗反应预测。结合影像、基因组和临床数据的多模态AI方法，与传统方法相比，可提供更优的患者分层和个体化治疗规划。除诊断外，AI通过基于影像组学的结节分类、多组学数据解释和药物发现促进治疗开发。尤其是影像组学，可提取超越人类感知的定量影像生物标志物，以捕捉肿瘤异质性。AI进一步支持外科、放疗和全身治疗的临床决策，提高工作流程效率。尽管在数据质量、可解释性和临床采用方面存在挑战，AI在推进精准肿瘤学和改善NSCLC管理结局方面具有重大前景。

abstract: Synthesizing realistic tumors on medical images helps address data scarcity for clinical AI. Existing diffusion-based methods, however, lack fine-grained attribute-level controllability, closed-loop quality verification, and awareness of which morphological patterns are underrepresented in the target distribution. We present MATS, a multi-agent framework for text-controllable, cross-organ tumor synthesis. Given a target disease, MATS first profiles its morphological distribution over a fine-grained attribute space covering tumor geometry and appearance, and constructs a generation plan that amplifies underrepresented subtypes while keeping common ones dominant. It then localizes the target organ, proposes anatomically valid placement, and executes two-stage diffusion to produce the tumor mask and render texture, each conditioned on the corresponding attributes. A closed-loop reflective mechanism verifies attribute alignment at three checkpoints throughout synthesis and provides targeted feedback to guide re-generation when misalignment is detected. Trained exclusively on a single-source pancreatic neuroendocrine tumor dataset, MATS consistently improves downstream segmentation both in-domain and across LiTS, KiTS, and MSD-Pancreas benchmarks, whereas most prior generative augmentation methods fall below real-only training.
zh_abstract: 在医学图像上合成逼真肿瘤有助于解决临床AI的数据稀缺问题。然而，现有基于扩散的方法缺乏细粒度属性级可控性、闭环质量验证，以及对目标分布中哪些形态模式代表性不足的感知。我们提出MATS，一种用于文本可控、跨器官肿瘤合成的多智能体框架。给定目标疾病，MATS首先在涵盖肿瘤几何和外观的细粒度属性空间上刻画其形态分布，并构建生成计划，以扩增代表性不足的亚型，同时保持常见亚型占主导。然后定位目标器官，提出解剖学上有效的放置方案，并执行两阶段扩散以生成肿瘤掩膜并渲染纹理，每一步均以相应属性为条件。闭环反思机制在合成全过程的三个检查点验证属性对齐，并在检测到错位时提供针对性反馈以指导重新生成。MATS仅在单源胰腺神经内分泌肿瘤（pancreatic neuroendocrine tumor）数据集上训练，却在域内以及跨LiTS、KiTS和MSD-Pancreas基准上持续改善下游分割，而大多数既往生成式增强方法低于仅用真实数据训练。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: University College, London; conditions: Sensorineural Hearing Loss, Tinnitus; type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 84; status: ENROLLING_BY_INVITATION] Background and study aims Hearing problems are becoming more common. In the UK around 18 million adults have hearing loss or hear ringing or buzzing in their ears, which is called tinnitus. Many people wait a long time to be seen, partly because there are not enough audiologists - the specialists who test hearing and treat hearing problems. The standard hearing test is called pure-tone audiometry. An audiologist plays quiet sounds at different pitches through headphones and the person presses a button each time they hear one. The test is accurate, but it takes 20 to 30 minutes to complete, and needs a trained audiologist for all of that time. For people with tinnitus and comorbidity it can be especially tiring and slow. The research team has built a version of this test that uses artificial intelligence, called AI-PTA. Instead of following a fixed pattern, it chooses each sound based on the responses already given, which should mean fewer sound presentations are needed to find the same result. The audiologist stays with the person throughout and remains in charge of the test. This study asks three questions. 1. Does AI-PTA give the same hearing results as the standard test? 2. Is it quicker? 3. And do patients and staff find it acceptable? Who can participate? Adults aged 18 or over who have been diagnosed with sensorineural hearing loss, either with or without tinnitus, and who are due to attend the Royal National ENT \& Eastman Dental Hospital in London. Participants need enough English to read and complete questionnaires and to be able to give informed consent. People who have or report hyperacusis (an unusual sensitivity to everyday sounds), an active ear infection, or recent ear surgery cannot take part. What does the study involve? People who are interested are sent information about two weeks before a hospital appointment they already have. Those who decide to take part come in about 30 minutes early, meet a research audiologist, discuss the study, and if happy to take part, sign a consent form. They fill in a short questionnaire about their hearing health. They then have two hearing tests at that visit: the standard test, which is part of their normal care, and the AI-PTA test. Half of the participants have the standard test first and half have AI-PTA first, so that the order does not affect the results. They come back within a week for a shorter appointment, about 40 minutes, to repeat the AI-PTA test. This shows whether it gives the same response

AI-PTA给出的听力结果是否与标准测试相同？2. 它是否更快？3. 患者和工作人员是否觉得它可以接受？【谁可以参与？】年龄18岁或以上、已被诊断为感音神经性听力损失（伴或不伴耳鸣），并计划前往伦敦Royal National ENT & Eastman Dental Hospital就诊的成年人。参与者需要具备足够的英语能力来阅读和完成问卷，并能够给出知情同意。患有或报告听觉过敏（hyperacusis，对日常声音异常敏感）、活动性耳部感染或近期接受耳部手术的人不能参加。【研究包括什么？】感兴趣的人会在其已有的医院预约前约两周收到研究信息。决定参加的人提前约30分钟到达，与研究听力学家会面，讨论研究，如果愿意参加，则签署知情同意书。他们填写一份关于听力健康的简短问卷。然后在该次就诊中进行两项听力测试：标准测试（其常规照护的一部分）和AI-PTA测试。一半参与者先做标准测试，一半先做AI-PTA，以免顺序影响结果。他们在一周内回来参加一次约40分钟的较短预约，以重复AI-PTA测试。这显示其是否给出相同反应

title: TIM: Temporal Decoupling with Iterative Mutual-Refinement Model for Longitudinal Radiology Report Generation

abstract: Automatic radiology report generation (RRG) aims to translate medical images into diagnostic text, reducing radiologists' workload and standardizing clinical documentation. Nonetheless, existing approaches mainly focus on single-timepoint analysis and fail to capture temporal disease evolution across longitudinal examinations. zh_abstract: 自动放射学报告生成（automatic radiology report generation, RRG）旨在将医学图像转化为诊断文本，减少放射科医师的工作量并规范临床文档记录。然而，现有方法主要集中于单时间点分析，未能捕捉纵向检查中的疾病时间演变。尽管近期纵向RRG（longitudinal RRG, LRRG）方法纳入了历史数据，但它们常将不同时间点的图像组合在单一表示空间中，导致语义模糊和时间推理不一致。在本工作中，我们提出时间解耦与迭代互精炼模型（Temporal Decoupling with Iterative Mutual-Refinement Model, TIM），这是一个两阶段框架，明确将空间病理与时间进展解耦，并通过相互反馈迭代精炼报告。第一阶段执行时间解耦表示学习，分离时间演化模式
